official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
TranslateImage translates the text inside images and redraws it in place, so a manga page, screenshot, product photo, menu, sign or document comes back in your language with its layout intact.

Attach an image in ChatGPT, or give a link to one, and ask:

• "Translate this manga page into English" — speech bubbles are cleaned and re-lettered.

• "What does this menu say?" — the text is read out (OCR) with the detected language.

• "Remove the text from this banner" — the lettering is erased and the background rebuilt.

You get a preview in the chat, a link to the full-size result, and the original and translated text side by side. More than 130 languages are supported, including Japanese, Korean, Chinese, English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Russian and Arabic.

Sign in with your TranslateImage account to connect. Results are also saved to your history at translateimage.io.
